newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the panhandle area late Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 3,600 Slaughter steers and 1,200 heifers; 78,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 26,000 formulated and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 66.00. Pen
select, few choice 2-3 1050 lbs 65.00. Utility and choice 2-4
